harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Implemented host-based port isolation between node2 and node3 (both RHEL7, sharing the 10.100.80.0/24 segment with node1) using firewalld rich rules: node2 drops all traffic sourced from node3's IP (10.100.80.12) and node3 drops all traffic sourced from node2's IP (10.100.80.11), applied both at runtime and permanently. Verified direct node2<->node3 ping fails (100% loss) while both retain full bidirectional connectivity to node1. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three managed nodes (node1 via SONiC `reboot`, node2/node3 via RHEL7 `sudo reboot`), confirming a changed OS boot_id and full recovery of services, firewalld state, and isolation behavior after each restart before proceeding to the next node.
actions_performed: Captured baseline: node2<->node3 ping succeeded and both reached node1 before any change
Applied firewalld rich-rule on node2 dropping source 10.100.80.12 (runtime + --permanent)
Applied firewalld rich-rule on node3 dropping source 10.100.80.11 (runtime + --permanent)
Verified isolation: node2->node3 and node3->node2 ping 100% loss; node2->node1 and node3->node1 ping succeeded
Verified node1 can still reach both node2 and node3 (uplink direction)
Verified isolation rules persisted through firewalld --reload on both node2 and node3
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service-health baselines on node1, node2, node3

Restarted node1 (SONiC reboot), polled ~19 minutes until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (82b18f3b...->b357bed2...), confirmed SONiC docker containers up and node1 could ping both node2 and node3
Re-verified port isolation still intact after node1 restart (node2/node3 still blocked from each other, still reaching node1)

Restarted node2 (RHEL7 sudo reboot), polled until reachable (~2 min), confirmed boot_id changed (16724682...->bcf4d4fa...), confirmed firewalld active, isolation rule against node3 persisted, node1 reachable, node3 still blocked

Restarted node3 (RHEL7 sudo reboot), polled until reachable (~4 min), confirmed boot_id changed (f0f8b8e0...->3ef00698...), confirmed firewalld active, isolation rule against node2 persisted, node1 reachable, node2 still blocked
Final cross-check on node2 confirming node1 reachable and node3 still blocked post all-node restarts

evidence.summary: node2->node3 and node3->node2 ping 100% loss; node2->node1 and node3->node1 succeed; node1->node2/node3 succeed (uplink direction)

evidence.requirement: Isolation rules are persistent (survive firewalld reload)
evidence.summary: firewall-cmd --reload followed by --list-rich-rules shows rule still present on both nodes

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: acknowledgement + changed boot identity + recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node repeatedly unreachable during reboot; boot_id changed to b357bed2-50b8-4e81-84b0-e0081aefd97c; all SONiC containers back up and node1 pinged both node2 and node3 successfully post-restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: isolation preserved across restart

evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; node unreachable during reboot; boot_id changed to bcf4d4fa-15cf-43e4-9997-a24d471cbf64; firewalld active, isolation rule against node3 persisted, node1 reachable, node3 still blocked

evidence.summary: Pre-restart boot_id f0f8b8e0-5ebe-465b-8853-020a1ffc5b08 and active firewalld captured

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: acknowledgement + changed boot identity + recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; node unreachable during reboot; boot_id changed to 3ef00698-6c71-495c-bf26-c90f926f3c98; firewalld active, isolation rule against node2 persisted, node1 reachable, node2 still blocked

evidence.requirement: Final state confirms full recovery with isolation intact across all three restarted nodes
evidence.summary: Post all-restarts check: node2 reaches node1, remains blocked from node3
